title: Schema for the response of a rule function to build system commands

declareoutput.description: The response to the build system command 'queryreturn' describing the value that would be returned from the rule function without actually performing any work.

$schema.description: The dk build system schema for responses from rule functions. Used by VS Code for auto-completions, but otherwise ignored.

return_objects.description: The objects that will be returned from the rule function.

id.description: The MODULE@VERSION of the form that will be returned from the rule function. The MODULE@VERSION form may be defined in a sibling [values].

slots.description: The object slots created by the form.

execution_slot.description: The slot that will be used for execution when the rule is executed. Use slot wildcards like `Release.execution_abi` for cross-platform.

return_asset.description: The asset value that will be returned from the rule function.

id.description: The MODULE@VERSION that will be returned from the rule function. The MODULE@VERSION may come from a sibling [values].

path.description: The path of the asset to return.

input_bundles.description: Static bundle inputs that the rule depends on.

id.description: The MODULE@VERSION bundle dependency of the rule.

input_assets.description: Static asset inputs that the rule depends on.

id.description: The MODULE@VERSION asset dependency of the rule.

path.description: The asset path dependency of the rule.

input_objects.description: Static object inputs that the rule depends on.

id.description: The MODULE@VERSION form dependency of the rule.

slots.description: The object slots published by the dependency.

execution_slot.description: The slot that will be used for execution when the rule is executed. Use slot wildcards like `Release.execution_abi` for cross-platform.

submit.description: The response to the build system command 'submit'. First the values in the [valuejson] field will be added to the valuestore. Then the [expressions] will be evaluated. Finally the [andthen] logic is performed.

$schema.description: The dk build system schema for responses from rule functions. Used by VS Code for auto-completions, but otherwise ignored.

values.description: Values to be added to the valuestore and to the task graph. The `forms[].function` field may be written as `forms[].function_` to avoid conflicts with the Lua `function` keyword.

expressions.description: Expressions to be added to [request.continued] after [values] is added to the valuestore and task graph. Expressions can be literal strings, variable references and/or subshells.

files.description: Expressions that should be evaluated as file paths.

directories.description: Expressions that should be evaluated as directory paths.

strings.description: Expressions that should be evaluated as strings. This is rarely the right choice for subshells.

items.description: Value shell words for a single value shell command

continue_.description: Logic to be performed after the [values] have been added and the [expressions] evaluated. Either continue to the next state by specifying [continue_] or return a value by not specifying a [continue_].

passthrough.description: Properties to pass through to the next state in its [request.continued] parameter.
